mac_ack.name: Acknowledge + investigating
mac_ack.body: Hi {{first_name}}, thanks for flagging {{issue_summary}}. We're on it - expect an update from us by {{eta}}.

mac_pending_chase.name: Pending check-in
mac_pending_chase.body: Hi {{first_name}}, just checking in on {{subject}} - are you still seeing this on your side? If we don't hear back by {{close_date}} we'll close the ticket, and you can always reopen it.

mac_password_reset.name: Password reset walkthrough
mac_password_reset.body: Hi {{first_name}}, sorry the reset email is playing hide and seek. We've triggered a fresh one from {{sender_address}} - if it isn't there in 10 minutes, ask your IT folks to allowlist that address and we'll send another.
